name: סכום במקומות הזוגיים
note: Positional aggregate: sum of the elements at indices 0,2,4,... reduced mod 16 (empty gives 0).

name: מספר העליות
src: l=>{ let c=0; for(let i=1;i<l.length;i++) if(l[i]>l[i-1]) c++; return c; }
note: Counts ascents: neighbouring pairs where the later element is larger (fewer than 2 elements gives 0).

name: מספר פסגות
src: l=>{ let c=0; for(let i=1;i+1<l.length;i++) if(l[i]>l[i-1]&&l[i]>l[i+1]) c++; return c; }
note: Counts interior local maxima, each compared with both neighbours; the ends never count.

name: שרשרת ערכים עוקבים
src: l=>{ let best=0; for(const x of l){ if(l.includes(x-1)) continue; let k=1; while(l.includes(x+k)) k++; if(k>best) best=k; } return best; }
note: Longest chain of consecutive values x,x+1,...,x+k-1 all present in the list, regardless of position (empty gives 0).
how: זוגות: c(x)=קפל_{y∈nall} חיסור(c, שווה (מספרים)(c, חיסור(y, x))) מ-0 · r⇐מקסימום נייד(self, c) (מ-0) ⇒ r

name: XOR של כולם
note: Bitwise XOR fold over the whole list, 0 for the empty list.
how: קיפול [שונה (מספרים), התחלה 0] על כל האיברים ⇒ כמו שהוא

name: AND של כולם
note: Bitwise AND fold over the whole list with identity 15, so the empty list gives 15.
how: קיפול [וגם (מספרים), התחלה 15] על כל האיברים ⇒ כמו שהוא

name: סכום שני הגדולים
note: Top-two sum mod 16 (always above 15 internally when two elements exist); one element gives itself, empty gives 0.

name: שאריות שונות ב-4
note: Counts how many distinct remainders mod 4 occur in the list (0..4).

name: כמה מעל הממוצע
note: Scores above average: compares each element with the mean via x*n > sum, a total far above 15 (empty gives 0).
how: דקדוק: g.sub(g.n, agg.len(d.segs(l.id, a, ((a * g.n) <= g.sum)))) · תת-משימה ⇐ מצב-רחב-2

name: הקפיצה הגדולה
src: l=>{ let m=0; for(let i=1;i<l.length;i++) m=Math.max(m,Math.abs(l[i]-l[i-1])); return m; }
note: Largest absolute difference between neighbouring elements (biggest price swing); fewer than 2 elements gives 0.

name: הפרש בין החצאים
src: l=>{ const h=l.length>>1; let a=0,b=0; for(let i=0;i<h;i++){ a+=l[i]; b+=l[l.length-1-i]; } return Math.min(15,Math.abs(a-b)); }
note: Absolute difference between the sums of the first and second halves (middle of an odd list ignored), sums up to 54 internally, capped at 15.

name: ארגזים של 10
note: Packing: total (up to 92) divided by a capacity of 10, rounded up, i.e. boxes needed (empty gives 0).

name: ההזמנה שחצתה את 20
src: l=>{ let s=0; for(const x of l){ s+=x; if(s>20) return x; } return 0; }
note: Running total over orders: returns the order value at which the total first exceeds 20, or 0 if it never does.
how: מצב-רחב-2: תקציב 20 · g=x · האיבר שבו הסכום עבר

name: כמה לא במקום בתור
note: Counts positions whose element differs from the ascending-sorted list (0 means the queue is already in order).

name: דלי הדירוג של הממוצע
src: l=>{ const n=l.length; if(!n) return 0; const s=l.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0); return s<10*n?1:(s<12*n?2:3); }
note: Buckets the mean rating without dividing: 1 if mean<10, 2 if mean<12, else 3; empty list gives 0.
how: מצב-רחב: צובר S+=x ⇒ S חלקי n ⇒ לוח שנלמד

name: התא הפנוי הבא
src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return 8; let v=l[l.length-1]; for(let k=0;k<7;k++){ v=v===15?8:v+1; if(!l.includes(v)) return v; } return 0; }
note: Round-robin locker allocation: the first locker in 8..15 not taken, searching cyclically after the most recently taken one (last element); empty gives 8, all taken gives 0.

name: המוצר הזול ביותר
note: Cheapest item: the minimum of the list; 0 for the empty list.

name: סכום ביקורת
note: Checksum: the total of all elements (up to 92) reduced mod 16; 0 for the empty list.

name: הפריט השלישי
note: Element at fixed index 2 (the third item); 0 when the list is shorter than 3.

name: מספר עמודים
note: Pagination: number of pages needed to show the list at 3 items per page (0 for empty).

name: רווח מקסימלי ממניה
src: l=>{ let m=0, lo=16; for(const x of l){ if(x-lo>m) m=x-lo; if(x<lo) lo=x; } return m; }
note: Best buy-then-sell profit: max of l[j]-l[i] over i<j, 0 if prices never rise.

name: טווח המחירים
note: Price spread: largest minus smallest element; 0 for the empty list.

name: מדליית ארד
note: Third largest value (bronze medal); 0 when the list has fewer than 3 elements.

name: איבר בשני שלישים
note: Element at original index floor(2n/3), the two-thirds position computed from the length; 0 for an empty list.

name: אמצע ההפוך
src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return 0; const r=[...l].reverse(); return r[r.length>>1]; }
note: Middle element of the reversed list (index floor(n/2) after reversing, i.e. the lower-middle of the original); 0 if empty.

name: רבעון עליון
src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return 0; const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>a-b); return s[(3*(s.length-1))>>2]; }
note: Upper quartile: sorted ascending, take index floor(3*(n-1)/4); 0 for an empty list.

name: המרחק בין הקצוות
note: Absolute difference between the last and the first element; 0 for empty or single-element lists.

name: ראשון מעל 11
note: 0-based index of the first element greater than 11; 15 when there is none (including empty).

name: מרחק מקסימום ממינימום
note: Distance between the positions of the max and the min (absolute index difference); 0 if empty.

name: גדולים מהאחרון
note: Counts elements larger than the last element; 0 for an empty list.

name: קטנים מהראשון
note: Number of inversions with the first element: later elements smaller than l[0]; 0 if empty.
how: דקדוק: agg.len(d.segs(l.id, a, (a < g.l0))) · תת-משימה ⇐ סריקה-עם-זיכרון

name: מספר היפוכים
src: l=>{ let c=0; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<l.length;j++) if(l[i]>l[j]) c++; return Math.min(c,15); }
note: Total number of inverted pairs (i<j with l[i]>l[j]), capped at 15 since it can reach 28.

name: פער המנצח
src: l=>{ if(l.length<2) return 0; const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>b-a); return s[0]-s[1]; }
note: Winning margin: largest minus second largest value; 0 when fewer than 2 elements.
